item.text:
Fixed the pagination offset in [src/offset.js](/private/var/folders/dm/w7qx09bd6sl715ck1d953lh80000gn/T/tmp.MnWScAi1uT/src/offset.js): page numbers start at 1, so the offset is now `(page - 1) * perPage`.

Verified with `pnpm test`: all 4 tests pass.
